clues.title: Pedestrian sign: Vibes
text: Hong Kong is a densely populated city with millions of inhabitants.
In urban areas, modern skyscrapers are common, with busy streets filled with vehicles and pedestrians.
In many cases, this vibe alone should be sufficient to identify urban Hong Kong locations.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Architecture: Tall Buildings
text: One very striking aspect of Hong Kong architecture are the many extremely tall apartment buildings found throughout the city.
Apartment buildings in Singapore and Taiwan tend to be not nearly as tall as those in Hong Kong.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Air Conditioners
text: Because of the subtropical climate, air conditioners attached to the walls of apartments are very common in Hong Kong.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Architecture: Taxis
text: **Hong Kong taxis come in two variants:**
Sedans or station wagons, with the sedans most commonly seen.
They can be easily identified by their silver roofs, green stickers on the front and rear bumper, and the taxi sign on the roof.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Sign: Road Signs
text: Road signs are white and rectangular, with a thick black outline and bilingual text.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Road line: Roadlines
text: Hong Kong usually uses white centre lines and white or yellow outer lines.
These lines can be single, double or dashed.
Yellow outer lines are most commonly found on small roads to indicate no-stopping.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Plate: Hong Kong
text: Hong Kong has white front licence plates and yellow rear licence plates. The licence plates can be long or short. Some cars have an additional black mainland Chinese licence plate.
